subject.title: Clarify or preserve skill source provenance from CLI publish

question: What permanent contract should `clawhub skill publish` use for client-declared repository, commit, ref, and path metadata?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the deliberate current boundary but cannot determine whether maintainers want a verified publishing flow, a separately labeled attribution field, or removal of metadata that has no supported public behavior.

options.title: Document then verify
options.body: Document the current limitation now and design a server-verified publishing path before any source claim can become trusted provenance.

options.title: Expose unverified attribution
options.body: Persist the publisher claim separately with prominent unverified labeling and prohibit its use by verification, trust, ranking, or install decisions.

options.title: Deprecate the flags
options.body: Remove or deprecate the skill source flags if ClawHub does not intend to retain or display their metadata.

recommendation.title: Document then verify
recommendation.body: Document the current limitation now and design a server-verified publishing path before any source claim can become trusted provenance.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged GitHub-backed source implementation provides the closest feature-history ownership for selecting how ordinary CLI publishing should integrate with that trusted path.
